text.p: Scientific-Atlanta Inc said Tuesday it had adopted a shareholder rights plan to deter abusive or coercive takeover tactics and to boost shareholder value if a takeover offer is made.
The rights plan replaces a plan that was to expire April 13, Scientific-Atlanta said.
Under the new plan, Scientific-Atlanta declared a dividend of one right to purchase 1/1,000 share of a new series of preferred stock for each share of common stock held.
The dividend is payable to shareholders of record April 13.

Scientific-Atlanta said the rights cannot be exercised until a person or group acquires more than 15 percent of its common stock, a tender offer is made for that amount, or the board deems a shareholder with more than a 10 percent stake as an "adverse person."
The rights plan is not a response to any takeover attempt and the company is not aware of any takeover attempt, Scientific-Atlanta said.
In certain events, the rights entitle the holders to acquire common stock of the company or of a potential acquirer having a market value equal to twice the exercise price of the rights, it said.
